prompt: A cinematic night shot of a narrow rain-soaked alley, teal and orange lighting, a parked vintage scooter on the left and soft steam drifting from a vent on the right. The camera stays level at eye height and performs a slow, smooth, steady forward dolly move straight down the center of the alley, gliding toward the distant glowing lights in the fog. The walls and fire escapes slide past on both sides, the wet pavement reflections shift gently as the camera advances, and the scooter moves past the left edge of the frame. The camera does not tilt, pan or look down. Steady stabilized tracking motion, shallow haze, soft ambient rain and distant city hum.
